decisions.reason: Product A builds directly on the firm's established messaging and cloud expertise, so the firm can assimilate and improve it, making a drop highly unlikely.
As an email-to-SMS gateway closely related to the firm's existing email security and messaging services, it aligns with the firm's knowledge base and is likely to be refined rather than dropped.
The SMS-to-email gateway draws on the same related communication and integration capabilities, enabling the firm to recognise its value and keep improving it.
